questions.stem: A 56-year-old woman presents with weight loss and watery diarrhea. She also notices periumbilical pain and bloating after eating. She also complains of flushing episodes. On examination-rhonchi present, CVS-pansystolic murmur at tricuspid area increasing on inspiration noted. A small bowel x-ray reveals an area of narrowing and the lesion is surgically resected. The pathology report will be most likely
